shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | sed -n '1,200p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- next docs transition matches ---'; rg -n \"view transition|ViewTransition|transition name|useTransitionRouter\" node_modules/next/dist/docs | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- view transition guide ---'; sed -n '1,430p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- link transitionTypes ---'; sed -n '470,535p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- config ---'; cat next.config.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- app files ---'; for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css lib/products.ts; do echo \"===== "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,280p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '90,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md; printf '\\n--- remaining guide ---\\n'; sed -n '280,410p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md; printf '\\n--- files ---\\n'; nl -ba app/layout.tsx; nl -ba app/page.tsx; nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx; nl -ba app/ProductSkeleton.tsx; nl -ba next.config.ts; nl -ba tsconfig.json; nl -ba AGENTS.md"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check; git status --short; git diff -- next.config.ts app/ProductGrid.tsx app/page.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css tsconfig.json; printf '\\n--- changed line references ---\\n'; nl -ba next.config.ts; nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx; nl -ba app/page.tsx; nl -ba 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx'; nl -ba app/globals.css | sed -n '1,340p'; nl -ba tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'

*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-    \"paths\": {
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
-    }
+    \"paths\": {
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
+    }
   },
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }

PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts
git diff --check
printf '%s\\n' '--- task diff stats ---'
git diff --stat -- next.config.ts app/ProductGrid.tsx app/page.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css
printf '%s\\n' '--- status ---'
git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- references ---'; rg -n \"viewTransition|ViewTransition|transitionTypes|product-morph|content-exit|nav-forward|prefers-reduced-motion\" next.config.ts app/ProductGrid.tsx app/page.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css"
